title: £800,000 Bridging Loan Refinance
h1: Not revealed by search results (search result title is "£800,000 Bridging Loan Refinance"; H1 not confirmed)
summary: Case study of an £800,000 like-for-like refinance of an existing bridging loan on a rented residential property in central London valued at £1.2 million. The borrower was a Kenyan national (long-standing client of an Isle of Man based trust company, which approached Silver Oak Capital on the client's behalf). The property had been bought at auction 12 months earlier using a bridging loan. Challenge: the borrower had no UK credit profile/history, making most lenders hesitant, plus standard KYC and anti-money-laundering checks; the firm had to source a Nairobi law firm to certify identity documents and notarise evidence of income covering rental void periods. Reported terms: £800,000 loan at 75% LTV, 5-year fixed rate of 4.19%, interest-only over a 5-year term, 1.50% bank fee. Lender not named (the phrase 'bank fee' implies a bank). Timing of completion and any further outcome statement were not present in the results.
